_meta.dataset: MICHELIN Guide New York — starred restaurants used in this trip plan
_meta.official_list_note: The 2025 New York selection (published 18 Nov 2025) is the current published official selection as of 2026-11-25. The next New York / Northeast Cities ceremony is 14 Dec 2026, after this snapshot; every star may change then. Source announcing next ceremony: https://michelinmedia.com/pages/blog/detail/article/c/a1479/
_meta.selection_counts_2026_11_02_secondary: A secondary source reports Michelin's own site listed 69 starred restaurants (5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star: 44 Manhattan, 5 Brooklyn, 1 Queens) as of 2 Nov 2026 — https://happy-hour.nyc/deals/best-michelin-star-restaurants-nyc (secondary; not used for any star value)
_meta.price_symbol_meaning: MICHELIN Guide price categories run from $ (inexpensive) to $$$$ (very expensive). A $$$$ symbol is an official Michelin band, NOT a dollar price. Dollar amounts appear only where a first-party menu price was found; otherwise the cell is blank and flagged.
_meta.hours_note: Hours are transcribed from each restaurant's MICHELIN Guide page (the Guide's listed opening hours). Holiday exceptions (e.g. 15 Feb 2027 = Presidents' Day, 18 Feb 2027 within NYC midwinter recess) are NOT published by the Guide and are therefore flagged as unverified for the trip dates.
_meta.encoding: Mon..Sun arrays. 'closed' = no service. Two ranges = lunch service; dinner service.
